note: Both sets contain identical claims, including the same factual errors (misreading 25-50C as 20-50C and 25,000 PSI as 20,000 PSI in specific claims) and the same duplicates (Nickel/Titanium composition and contraction/strain values listed multiple times). Since the content, errors, and redundancy are effectively the same, neither set is better.
